Class BaseAGEMOEA<S extends org.uma.jmetal.solution.Solution<?>>

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.algorithm.agemoea.BaseAGEMOEA<S>
Type Parameters:
S - the solution type handled by this algorithm
All Implemented Interfaces:
BaseLevelAlgorithm<S>
Direct Known Subclasses:
DoubleAGEMOEA, TreeAGEMOEA
public abstract class BaseAGEMOEA<S extends org.uma.jmetal.solution.Solution<?>> extends Object implements BaseLevelAlgorithm<S>
Abstract base class for configurable AGE-MOEA (Adaptive GEometry-based Many-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm) implementations.

This class provides a flexible foundation for building AGE-MOEA variants for different solution types. It manages the configuration and assembly of the main algorithmic components (selection, variation, replacement, evaluation, termination, etc.) through a parameter space abstraction. AGE-MOEA selects survivors using an adaptive geometry that approximates the Pareto front in normalized objective space; the variant of the geometry computation (original or AGE-MOEA-II) is chosen at runtime via the agemoeaVariant parameter.

Subclasses must implement setNonConfigurableParameters() to set any parameters derived from the problem instance.

See Also:
  • Pareto Front Estimation through Geometry and Adaptive Mating

    • createReplacement

      protected org.uma.jmetal.component.catalogue.ea.replacement.Replacement<S> createReplacement()
      Builds the AGE-MOEA replacement strategy. The agemoeaVariant categorical parameter determines which environmental selection is used: agemoea for the original analytical hyperplane fitting and agemoea2 for the AGE-MOEA-II Newton-Raphson based variant.
      Returns:
      the replacement strategy configured with the requested environmental selection
